title: The Captain of the Polestar, and Other Tales
sourceTitle: The Captain of the Polestar, and Other Tales
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
description: "The Captain of the 'Polestar' and Other Tales" by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle is a collection of short stories written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: The opening story focuses on a whaling expedition to the Arctic, narrated by John M'Alister Ray, a medical student on board a ship named the Polestar, captained by the enigmatic Nicholas Craigie. As they navigate through treacherous icy waters, tension builds not only from the perilous circumstances of their surroundings but also from the psychological complexities of the captain and the crew's growing discontent.

authorInfo.bio: Arthur Conan Doyle was a Scottish-born physician and author who created Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson. His detective stories made close observation central to the mystery genre. Beyond Holmes, he wrote historical fiction and adventure stories, including The Lost World.
authorInfo.edition: Complete collection of twelve stories. Cover reproduced from the Project Gutenberg source EPUB.
